---
title: "Publications"
description-meta: "Papers and preprints by Jacob Johnson"
title-block-banner: false

# Shared styles for the Publications and Presentations pages.
css:
  - files/publications/pub-listing.css

# The page content comes from a Quarto listing:
#   contents  -> the data. GENERATED from files/CV/publications.bib by
#                files/publications/bib_to_yml.py before every render.
#                To add or change a paper, edit the .bib, not this YAML.
#   template  -> how each entry is drawn
listing:
  - id: pubs
    contents: files/publications/publications.yml
    type: custom
    template: files/publications/pub-listing.ejs
    sort: false        # the template sorts newest first
    page-size: 200     # show everything on one page (no pagination)
---

<!-- The listing is inserted into this empty block. -->
:::{#pubs}
:::
